programmes.d: Schwoz invents a vacuum to help Henry clean his house, but it accidentally sucks Charlotte inside; when Henry's family hears Charlotte and thinks the vacuum is haunted, Ray must distract them while Henry finds a way to get her out.
Henry's life as Kid Danger is threatened when Charlotte grows suspicious about the secrets he has been keeping.
A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him.
Jasper gets the chance to take his crush to Cactus Con, but when a mysterious villain gets involved in the convention, the entire gang is forced into action.

When Ronnie Anne discovers that each family member will perform at Hector's birthday, she turns to Sid for help; Ronnie Anne's attempts to bond with her cool older cousin Carlota lead to a prank war against the boy cousins.
When Clyde thinks that his parents are having another baby, he seeks Lincoln's advice on how to be a big brother; a fight breaks out in the Loud house when Lori and Leni buy identical dresses.
Clyde, worried that Lincoln is hung up on Ronnie Anne, tries to cure his post-breakup blues; tired of her siblings walking all over her, Lucy turns to a spell book to teach her siblings a lesson.

Lori and Lincoln visit the city, where Lori struggles to be a city girl; Lincoln finds that Ronnie Anne has changed; the family uses stunt doubles in its plan to avoid Luan's April Fool's Day pranking.

When the Loud parents win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the children with them because the children have promised to behave; when Lucy gets a crush on a "regular and normal" boy, her sisters decide to give her a makeover.
Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day.
Lynn pushes Liam to his limits when he becomes the star pitcher for the middle school baseball team; Lincoln's friends try to stop him from performing a magic act at the middle school talent show.

When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated.

Mom takes over when Lucy quits the writing club at school due to the by-the-book way Huggins runs the club; Luna and Sam embark on a challenge taking place across Royal Woods and discover they have less in common than they thought.

The Loud family believe that they are safe from pranks on April Fool's Day because prankster Luan is away at camp; when the children discover that their father is not at his old job anymore, they begin to worry it might be their fault.
Lynn desperately wants to win a basketball championship but gets drafted onto a terrible team; Mom and Dad decide to build a secret bathroom after they become sick of waiting their turn in line.

Lincoln's social standing is at stake when his four-year-old sister is put into his fifth grade class; the children grow tired of their family van falling apart, so they decide to try to trick Dad into buying a cool, new van.
Mr. Krabs' mother starts to date; SpongeBob wants to make his own version of the "Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy" movie.
SpongeBob realizes he wants to fly with the jellyfish; Patchy uncovers a brand-new episode of SpongeBob and then loses it.

Scissors helps Paper have a weekend interesting enough to impress Pencil; even more exciting: Rock buys a hat; Rock, Paper and Scissors try to prove they shouldn't be replaced by their incredible new friend, Putty.

Rock, paper and scissors meet another trio with their same names; the trio tries to prove they're not the worst; rock and paper try to end a feud between scissors and a powerful magician before her magic ruins their lives.
Timmy and his fairies must save the city when Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pets with evil pets.
Timmy enters Cosmo and Wanda as goldfish in a contest at school; Timmy wishes his long forgotten imaginary friend to life.
Poof watches too much of a classic but violent cat and mouse cartoon; Crocker is concerned about Timmy's grades; Poof will not take his medicine.
Remy wants Timmy to be his best friend; Timmy sneaks into the castle in Cosmo and Wanda's fishbowl.
Timmy wishes his father had a cooler job; Timmy enters the Dimm-a-dance Film Festival to impress Trixie Tang.
Timmy wishes his life was like an action movie; Timmy turns into a genius just in time to take a test.

Timmy wishes the trash away; Timmy becomes the subject of a reality show.
Crocker wants an heir for his supposed fortune and fame; the Greek gods seek revenge when Timmy destroys Mount Olympus.

Timmy gets caught in the middle of a feud between Chester and A.J.; Timmy's mother starts predicting the weather.
Timmy wishes he was his father's sports car; Timmy accidentally releases the Crimson Chin's arch-villain, the Anti-Chin, into our world.
Timmy wishes the park animals would clean up after themselves; Timmy helps his mother make a viral video.
Timmy trades places with Cosmo and Wanda; Timmy gets into trouble when the bike he wished for becomes jealous.
Timmy wishes for super magician powers to perform at the fair; Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda are invited to a party at Cupid's house.

Timmy wishes that he could be a fly on the wall when he is forbidden from watching a horror film; when Cosmo and Wanda are busy taking care of Poof, Timmy wishes for a temporary fairy to fulfill his wishes.
Vicky uses underhanded tactics to try to win a beauty pageant; Timmy wishes that he can read people's minds.

When Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped, he mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy; when Timmy wishes that his father could be Mayor, he ends up getting tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.
